---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability with a concrete research or deployment use case
---

## Use case

What are you trying to build, and where does the current API fall short?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired interface or show a small usage example.

## Existing alternatives

Can existing components or a custom collaborator express this? Explain the limitation.

## Evidence and compatibility

Link relevant methods or implementations. Note any required device, dtype, compile/export,
or checkpoint compatibility. Separate desired behavior from measured results.
